even_Y_branch.consequence: The cross-side mask reduces to a two-term q-th-power system with an explicit dyadic coefficient rather than to Sahoo's plus family.
even_Y_branch.normal_form: Let k=v_2(Y). There are coprime odd positive u,v and positive alpha,beta with min(alpha,beta)=1 and alpha+beta=q*k such that U=2^alpha*u^q and V=2^beta*v^q.
even_Y_branch.parity: Y even iff X and Z are both odd

new_research_split.cross_side_double_square_mask: synchronized minus/plus cyclotomic descent with complementary q-local types, followed by a multi-Frey method
new_research_split.double_summand_square_mask: cofinal-quadrant closure and finitely many one-small-prime strips via Hilbert modular forms and S-units
new_research_split.one_square_mask: new asymmetric Frey/HGM system, beginning with (4,5,7)

nonclaim: This descent is unconditional but does not yet eliminate the cross-side mask. Its value is that it replaces the original equation by two synchronized perfect-power factorizations, with at most one q-exceptional branch.

exceptional_localization.coprime_consequence: Because gcd(X,Z)=1, the q-exceptional local type occurs in at most one of the two synchronized Frey systems
exceptional_localization.minus: q divides v-u if and only if q divides X
exceptional_localization.plus: q divides v+u if and only if q divides Z
exceptional_localization.proof: Fermat congruences give v^q-u^q congruent to v-u mod q and v^q+u^q congruent to v+u mod q; compare with 2*X^p and 2*Z^r

minus_cyclotomic_split.exceptional_case: if q divides v-u, then v-u=2*q^(p*h-1)*a^p and Phi_q(v,u)=q*b^p for some h>=1
minus_cyclotomic_split.pure_case: if q does not divide v-u, then v-u=2*a^p and Phi_q(v,u)=b^p

odd_Y_branch.parity: Y odd iff X and Z have opposite parity

plus_cyclotomic_split.exceptional_case: if q divides v+u, then v+u=2*q^(r*k-1)*c^r and Phi_(2q)(v,u)=q*d^r for some k>=1
plus_cyclotomic_split.pure_case: if q does not divide v+u, then v+u=2*c^r and Phi_(2q)(v,u)=d^r

odd_Y_branch.split: There are coprime odd positive u<v with U=u^q and V=v^q.
odd_Y_branch.synchronization: q cannot divide both v-u and v+u, so at least one of the two cyclotomic decompositions is completely pure.

scope: X,Y,Z pairwise-coprime positive integers and p,q,r odd primes
